_comment: Canonical Right Suite API host contract, owned by RightKit. Edit only here; scripts/gen-suite-api.mjs writes every projection (rightkit-license suite_api_generated.rs, @rightkit/app-update suite-api.generated.ts, @rightkit/release suite-api.generated.mjs) and a byte copy under crates/rightkit-license/test-vectors/. Path templates use {app} for the app key (filled by RightKit) and Tauri's {{target}} placeholder (filled by the updater at runtime). Hosts are bare hostnames; origins include the scheme.
